lineage: Independent of AAI-02B INVALID result; do not reuse its cohorts or integrate model
hypothesis: Causally consequential, noisy interventions can support a non-saturated structural-law discovery benchmark with meaningful evidence selection, unlike the AAI-02B fixed-priority task.

world.dynamics: law%4 permutes three state bits by identity/rotate-left/rotate-right/reverse; mask=[1,2,3,5][(action+(5*context+floor(context/4))%4)%4]; laws 0..3 use state_perm XOR mask; laws 4..7 use (state_perm+mask)%8
world.noise: 0.20 chance of flipping exactly one of 3 output bits; otherwise observation equals deterministic next state
world.terminal: state and target are independent keyed SHA256 draws, not generated from true law; one terminal action chooses 3-bit next state; reward=1-(number of differing target bits)/3
world.identifiability: Passive distribution exactly same for eight laws; every law pair distinguished by at least one state/action intervention; assert exhaustively

methods.bayes_utility: Exact eight-law Bayes likelihood and posterior; one-step utility-of-information planning over 32 possible action/state probes, terminal action maximizes expected reward
methods.bayes_eig: Exact Bayes with greedy information-gain intervention choice, same decoder
methods.bayes_random: Exact Bayes with deterministic hash-random intervention choice
methods.trained_tabular: Full 512-world supervised fit of Laplace-smoothed conditional event likelihoods over law/state/action-normalized/next state; four random interventions, fixed after training
methods.expert: Privileged true-law ceiling only; never valid superiority comparator
methods.recent: Retain eight most recent events including passive distractors; no learned law
methods.label_shuffle: Retrain conventional tabular likelihood with deterministically permuted TRAIN law labels; use separate NEGATIVE cohort

frozen_thresholds.admission: All criteria plus passive non-identifiability, pairwise active identifiability, cold restore, unchanged source, full final two-OS regression. Failure is NEGATIVE_BENCHMARK unless leakage/custody makes INVALID.

experimental_isolation: Contributor synthetic only, not native model, no controller, runner, schedule, queue, accepted ref, model weights, deployment or promotion
scientific_claim: Benchmark admission only; no novel associative superiority or AGI claim
future_direction: After admission, new preregistered mechanism AAI-03B vs strongest conventional and Bayes control with matched resources.
provenance: Prereg separate earlier commit; exact source, result, runner, SHA256 and CI logs archived in repository; no files to user's chat/library.
